label: TP
reason: User input flows through doSomething into bar and is concatenated into SQL query without parameterization, creating a direct SQL injection vector. The arithmetic guard in doSomething is always true, ensuring user input reaches the vulnerable SQL execution.

evidence.note: Query string parsing and URL decoding passes user input to doSomething()
Always-true arithmetic guard allows unfiltered user input to reach SQL query
Unsafe string concatenation of user-derived bar variable into SQL query
